#Loading Data
```{r}
#code for reading csv files locally
#Iron March
iron_march_core_members <-read.csv("core_members.csv", sep=',', header =TRUE) # Member Info
iron_march_core_message_posts <-read.csv("core_message_posts.csv", sep=',', header =TRUE) # Text of messages, replies to Private Messages
iron_march_core_message_topics <- read.csv("core_message_topics.csv", sep =',', header = TRUE) # Private Messages
iron_march_core_forum_posts <- read.csv("core_search_index.csv", sep =',', header = TRUE) # Posts and comments
```

# Posts/Topics

# Adding all titles to Posts/Topics in the dataset
```{r}
table(iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_class)

iron_march_core_forum_posts_ids <- 
sqldf("SELECT DISTINCT index_item_id, index_title
FROM iron_march_core_forum_posts 
where 
[index_class] = 'IPS\\forums\\Topic\\Post' AND
[index_title] != ' '
ORDER BY index_item_id")

iron_march_core_forum_posts_ids[iron_march_core_forum_posts_ids==""]<-NA # Change duplicates with empty cells to NA
iron_march_core_forum_posts_ids <- na.omit(iron_march_core_forum_posts_ids) # Remove the duplicates 

iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_title <- iron_march_core_forum_posts_ids$index_title[match(iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_item_id, iron_march_core_forum_posts_ids$index_item_id)]; # Match the ID to the title of the post in the original dataset
```

#DATES AND TIMES

##Convert timestamps Epoch to POSIXct - https://statisticsglobe.com/convert-unix-timestamp-to-date-object-in-r
```{r}
#Converting date columns
iron_march_core_members$joined <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_members$joined, origin="1970-01-01", tz="GMT")
iron_march_core_members$joined <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_members$joined, format="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M")

iron_march_core_members$last_visit <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_members$last_visit, origin="1970-01-01", tz="GMT")
iron_march_core_members$last_visit <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_members$last_visit, format="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M")

iron_march_core_members$last_activity <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_members$last_activity, origin="1970-01-01", tz="GMT")
iron_march_core_members$last_activity <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_members$last_activity, format="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M")

iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_date <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_date, origin="1970-01-01", tz="GMT")
iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_date <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_date, format="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M")

iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_date <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_date, origin="1970-01-01", tz="GMT")
iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_date <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_date, format="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M")
iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_start_time <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_date, origin="1970-01-01", tz="GMT")
iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_start_time <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_start_time, format="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M")
iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_last_post_time <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_last_post_time, origin="1970-01-01", tz="GMT")
iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_last_post_time <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_last_post_time, format="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M")

iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_created <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_created, origin="1970-01-01", tz="GMT")
iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_created  <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_created , format="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M")

iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_updated <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_updated, origin="1970-01-01", tz="GMT")
iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_updated <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_updated, format="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M")

```

##Convert POSIXct to Date + Split into D/M/Y, halfs, 
```{r}
# Confirm class is POSIXct
class(iron_march_core_members$joined) 
class(iron_march_core_members$last_visit) 
class(iron_march_core_members$last_activity) 
class(iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_date) 
class(iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_created) 
class(iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_updated) 
class(iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_date) 

# Dropping times and converting class to Date
# iron_march_core_members$joined  <- as.Date(iron_march_core_members$joined) 
# iron_march_core_members$last_visit  <- as.Date(iron_march_core_members$last_visit) 
# iron_march_core_members$last_activity  <- as.Date(iron_march_core_members$last_activity) 
# iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_date  <- as.Date(iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_date) 
# iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_date  <- as.Date(iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_date) 
# iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_created  <- as.Date(iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_created) 
# iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_updated  <- as.Date(iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_updated) 

# Adding halfs
iron_march_core_members$joined_half  <- semester(iron_march_core_members$joined, with_year = TRUE)
iron_march_core_members$last_visit_half  <- semester(iron_march_core_members$last_visit, with_year = TRUE)
iron_march_core_members$last_activity_half  <- semester(iron_march_core_members$last_activity, with_year = TRUE)
iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_date_half  <- semester(iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_date, with_year = TRUE)
iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_date_half  <- semester(iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_date, with_year = TRUE)
iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_created_half  <- semester(iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_created, with_year = TRUE)
iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_updated_half  <- semester(iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_date_updated, with_year = TRUE) 
iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_start_time  <- semester(iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_start_time, with_year =TRUE)
iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_last_post_time <-  semester(iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_last_post_time, with_year =TRUE)
```

```{r}
#Assessing inactive users based on: year joined and last activity + messages or posts made 
#what if a user was very active in one year and was arrested?
#Consider x2 below median for posting to be a cut off for inactive users on forum?

colnames(iron_march_core_members)

library(dplyr)
library(sqldf)

iron_march_inactive_users <- 
sqldf("SELECT member_id, name, joined_half, last_activity_half, msg_count_total, member_posts
FROM iron_march_core_members 
where (
[last_activity_half] == '2011.1' AND
[joined_half] == '2011.1' OR
[last_activity_half] == '2011.2' AND
[joined_half] == '2011.2' OR
[last_activity_half] == '2012.1' AND
[joined_half] == '2012.1' OR
[last_activity_half] == '2012.2' AND
[joined_half] == '2012.2' OR
[last_activity_half] == '2013.1' AND
[joined_half] == '2013.1' OR
[last_activity_half] == '2013.2' AND
[joined_half] == '2013.2' OR
[last_activity_half] == '2014.1' AND
[joined_half] == '2014.1' OR
[last_activity_half] == '2014.2' AND
[joined_half] == '2014.2' OR
[last_activity_half] == '2015.1' AND
[joined_half] == '2015.1' OR
[last_activity_half] == '2015.2' AND
[joined_half] == '2015.2' OR
[last_activity_half] == '2016.1' AND
[joined_half] == '2016.1' OR
[last_activity_half] == '2016.2' AND
[joined_half] == '2016.2' OR
[last_activity_half] == '2017.1' AND
[joined_half] == '2017.1' OR
[last_activity_half] == '2017.2' AND
[joined_half] == '2017.2'
) 
AND 

[msg_count_total] < 1 
AND [member_posts] < 1

ORDER BY joined_half")

iron_march_inactive_users

#[msg_count_total] < 1 AND [member_posts] < 1 = 35 users

```

### MESSAGE REVIEW - LABELLING AND IDENTIFYING USERS BASED ON KEYWORDS

##Cleaning up text in messages, posts and topic titles
```{r}
## Remove formatting clutter from text in messages
#tibble(iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_post) #check for code in text

iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_post<-gsub("</p>","", as.character(iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_post))
iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_post<-gsub("<p>","", as.character(iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_post))
iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_post<-gsub("\n","", as.character(iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_post))
iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_post<-gsub("\t","", as.character(iron_march_core_message_posts$msg_post))

## Remove formatting clutter from text in topic titles

#tibble(iron_march_core_message_topics$mt_title) #chck for code in topic titles / none found!
#tibble(iron_march_core_message_topics)

## Remove formatting clutter from text in posts

iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_content<-gsub("</p>","", as.character(iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_content))
iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_content<-gsub("<p>","", as.character(iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_content))
iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_content<-gsub("\n","", as.character(iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_content))
iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_content<-gsub("\t","", as.character(iron_march_core_forum_posts$index_content))
```

#Adding names to message and topic datasets
Creating message and topic dataframes joined with core_members:

iron_march_core_message_posts_names
iron_march_core_message_topics_names

```{r}

#Messages

colnames(iron_march_core_members)

iron_march_core_members_ids <- 
sqldf("SELECT DISTINCT member_id, name
FROM iron_march_core_members 
")

#colnames(iron_march_core_message_posts)

iron_march_core_message_posts_names1 <- iron_march_core_message_posts # New Dataframe
iron_march_core_message_posts_names1$msg_author_name <- NA # Add column to fill later

#colnames(iron_march_core_message_posts_names1)

names(iron_march_core_message_posts_names1)[names(iron_march_core_message_posts_names1) == "msg_author_id"] <- "member_id" #match core_members
names(iron_march_core_members_ids)[names(iron_march_core_members_ids) == "name"] <- "msg_author_name" #match posts dataframe

#colnames(iron_march_core_message_posts_names1) # check change worked
#colnames(iron_march_core_members_ids)  # check change worked

iron_march_core_message_posts_names1$msg_author_name <- iron_march_core_members_ids$msg_author_name[match(iron_march_core_message_posts_names1$member_id, iron_march_core_members_ids$member_id)]; # Match the ID to the title of the post in the original dataset
#head(iron_march_core_message_posts_names1)

```

```{r}
#Posts

# iron_march_core_members_ids
# index_author_name = author of the reply or comment on a Post/Topic

iron_march_core_forum_posts_names1 <- iron_march_core_forum_posts

colnames(iron_march_core_forum_posts) #confirm change

iron_march_core_forum_posts_names1$index_author_name <- NA # Add column to fill later

names(iron_march_core_forum_posts_names1)[names(iron_march_core_forum_posts_names1) == "index_author"] <- "member_id" #match core_members
names(iron_march_core_members_ids)[names(iron_march_core_members_ids) == "msg_author_name"] <- "index_author_name" #match posts dataframe

iron_march_core_forum_posts_names1$index_author_name <- iron_march_core_members_ids$index_author_name[match(iron_march_core_forum_posts_names1$member_id, iron_march_core_members_ids$member_id)]; # Match the ID to the title of the post in the original dataset

names(iron_march_core_forum_posts_names1)[names(iron_march_core_forum_posts_names1) == "member_id"] <- "index_author" #revert back

# index_item_author = author of the Post/Topic itself

iron_march_core_forum_posts_names1$index_item_author_name <- NA # Add column to fill later

names(iron_march_core_forum_posts_names1)[names(iron_march_core_forum_posts_names1) == "index_item_author"] <- "member_id" #match core_members
names(iron_march_core_members_ids)[names(iron_march_core_members_ids) == "index_author_name"] <- "index_item_author_name" #match posts dataframe

iron_march_core_forum_posts_names1$index_item_author_name <- iron_march_core_members_ids$index_item_author_name[match(iron_march_core_forum_posts_names1$member_id, iron_march_core_members_ids$member_id)]; # Match the ID to the title of the post in the original dataset

names(iron_march_core_forum_posts_names1)[names(iron_march_core_forum_posts_names1) == "member_id"] <- "index_item_author"  #revert back
names(iron_march_core_members_ids)[names(iron_march_core_members_ids) == "index_item_author_name"] <- "name"  #revert back

```

#Private Messages

```{r}

# iron_march_core_members_ids
# iron_march_core_message_topics

# mt_starter_id = author of first private message (outdegree)
# mt_to_member_id = receiver of the message (indegree)

iron_march_core_message_topics_names1 <- iron_march_core_message_topics

iron_march_core_message_topics_names1$mt_start_name <- NA # Add column to fill later
iron_march_core_message_topics_names1$mt_to_member_name <- NA # Add column to fill later

# mt_starter_id
names(iron_march_core_message_topics_names1)[names(iron_march_core_message_topics_names1) == "mt_starter_id"] <- "member_id" #match core_members
names(iron_march_core_members_ids)[names(iron_march_core_members_ids) == "name"] <- "mt_start_name" #match posts dataframe

iron_march_core_message_topics_names1$mt_start_name <- iron_march_core_members_ids$mt_start_name[match(iron_march_core_message_topics_names1$member_id, iron_march_core_members_ids$member_id)]; # Match the ID to the title of the post in the original dataset

names(iron_march_core_message_topics_names1)[names(iron_march_core_message_topics_names1) == "member_id"] <- "mt_starter_id" #revert back
names(iron_march_core_members_ids)[names(iron_march_core_members_ids) == "mt_start_name"] <- "mt_to_member_name" #match next dataframe

# head(iron_march_core_message_topics_names1)

#1005 0s
sqldf("SELECT count(mt_starter_id)
FROM iron_march_core_message_topics_names1
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(sqldf)

#colnames(iron_march_core_message_posts_names1)
colnames(iron_march_core_message_all_completed)

#Atomwaffen Divison, National Action, SKD, FKD

iron_march_terrorist_keyword_messages <- 
sqldf("SELECT msg_date, message_sender_id, message_sender_name, msg_post, msg_id, msg_date_half, message_receiver_id, message_receiver_name
FROM iron_march_core_message_all_completed 
where ([msg_post] like '%waffen%' OR
[msg_post] like '%awd%' OR
[msg_post] like '%national action%' OR
[msg_post] like '%division%' OR
[msg_post] like '%feuerkrieg%' OR
[msg_post] like '%sonnenkrieg%')
ORDER BY msg_date")

write.csv(iron_march_terrorist_keyword_messages,"iron_march_terrorist_keywords_messages.csv", row.names = FALSE)

#Joining/Recruiting 
iron_march_recruitment_messages <- 
sqldf("SELECT msg_date, message_sender_id, message_sender_name, msg_post, msg_id, msg_date_half, message_receiver_id, message_receiver_name
FROM iron_march_core_message_all_completed 
WHERE
([msg_post] like '%waffen%' OR
[msg_post] like '%awd%' OR
[msg_post] like '%national action%' OR
[msg_post] like '%division%' OR
[msg_post] like '%feuerkrieg%' OR
[msg_post] like '%sonnenkrieg%')

AND 
([msg_post] like '%join%' OR
[msg_post] like '%website%' OR
[msg_post] like '%contact%' OR
[msg_post] like '%email%' OR
[msg_post] like '%skype%' OR
[msg_post] like '%telegram%')
ORDER BY msg_date")

write.csv(iron_march_recruitment_messages,"iron_march_recruitment_messages.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
#member_id = index_author which is the member who created the comments (index_content) on the Post 
#index_item_author is the user who created the post (index_item_index_id).
#The text in index_title by the index_item_author is the title of the post.
```

#Moderators
650 moderators during course of the forum. 29% of members at the end are moderators.

```{r}

#32547 rows
#describe(iron_march_mod) #member_id 0 does not exist - this is an error
iron_march_mod <- iron_march_mod[iron_march_mod$member_id != 0, ] #28665 rows
iron_march_mod$ctime <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_mod$ctime, origin="1970-01-01", tz="GMT")
iron_march_mod$ctime <- as.POSIXct(iron_march_mod$ctime, format="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M")
iron_march_mod$mod_half  <- semester(iron_march_mod$ctime, with_year = TRUE)

#---------> Analysis of Mods <----------

# Convert to date for analysis 
iron_march_mod$ctime= as.Date(iron_march_mod$ctime, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
class(iron_march_mod$ctime)

# Slice for first date for each ID
im_mod_unique <- iron_march_mod %>%
    group_by(member_id) %>%
    arrange(ctime) %>%
    slice(1L)

# Now change mod_half to factor for graph
im_mod_unique$mod_half <- as.factor(im_mod_unique$mod_half) # change to factor

mod_count <- im_mod_unique %>%
  group_by(mod_half) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(Freq = round(n/sum(n)*100, digits = 2))

class(mod_count$mod_half) # factor

# remove NAs
mod_count <- na.omit(mod_count) 

# bar chart
mod_count %>%  
  ggplot( aes(x=mod_half, y=n)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", alpha=.6, width=.4) +
    xlab("") +
    theme_bw() + 
  ggtitle("Count of When Members Become Moderators by Half") +
  xlab("Year and Half") + ylab("Count of Memebrs") +
geom_label(
    aes(label=n), 
    nudge_x = 0, nudge_y = 15, 
    check_overlap = T,
    size = 3) 

#---------> Prep Mods for Member Dataset <---------

# Join to get join date AND first activity as a mod
iron_march_first_mod_ids <- 
sqldf("SELECT 
y.member_id,
y.name,
y.email,
y.joined,
y.joined_half,
y.msg_count_total,
y.members_profile_views,
y.member_posts,
y.last_visit_half,
y.last_activity,
y.last_activity_half,
x.ctime,
x.mod_half
FROM iron_march_mod x
JOIN iron_march_features y
ON y.member_id = x.member_id")
iron_march_first_mod_ids

# Identify members who became mods when they joined
iron_march_first_mod_ids <- 
sqldf("SELECT DISTINCT member_id
FROM iron_march_first_mod_ids
WHERE [mod_half] == [joined_half]
ORDER BY member_id")

iron_march_first_mod_ids$role <- "Iron March Moderator"
iron_march_first_mod_ids
```

```{r}
# http://www.sthda.com/english/wiki/ggplot2-title-main-axis-and-legend-titles

# DF with no. of counts for each role
role_count <- iron_march_members %>%
  group_by(member_role) %>% # grouping and ordering in alphabetical order
  summarise(counts = n())

role_count

# Reorder following the value of another column:
role_count %>% filter(member_role != c("Iron March Member", "Iron March Moderator")) %>% # exclude IM member  + mod
  mutate(member_role = fct_reorder(member_role, counts)) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x=member_role, y=counts)) +
```

```{r}
sqldf("SELECT DISTINCT index_item_author_name, index_title, index_date_created, index_date_created_half
FROM iron_march_core_forum_posts_edges
```

```{r}
iron_march_edges_ids <- iron_march_edges  # New Dataframe
iron_march_edges_ids$source_id <- NA # Add column to fill later

iron_march_edges_ids$source_id <- iron_march_nodes_source$source_id[match(iron_march_edges_ids$source, iron_march_nodes_source$source)]; # Match the ID and name source

# ----> Create Target ID Column <-------

iron_march_edges_ids$target_id <- NA # Add column to fill later

iron_march_nodes_target<- iron_march_nodes
names(iron_march_nodes_target)[names(iron_march_nodes_target) == "id"] <- "target_id" #match iron_march_edges_ids

iron_march_edges_ids$target_id <- iron_march_nodes_target$target_id[match(iron_march_edges_ids$target, iron_march_nodes_target$target)]; # Match the ID 

head(iron_march_edges_ids) # check it worked - it does
describe(iron_march_edges_ids) # same row count

# ----> Cleanup for network object <-------

sum(is.na(iron_march_edges_ids$source_id)) #0
sum(is.na(iron_march_edges_ids$target_id)) #0

iron_march_edges_ids_prep <- select(iron_march_edges_ids, source_id, target_id, type, timestamp, "time half")
```

```{r}
#----> NetworkX Prep <-----

# Messages between users 
iron_march_edges_networkx_contagion <- iron_march_edges_gephi

# Simple contagion model
iron_march_edges_networkx <- select(iron_march_edges_networkx_contagion, source, target)
write.csv(iron_march_edges_networkx,"iron_march_edges_networkx.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Create weights of messages
iron_march_edges_networkx_contagion <- iron_march_edges_networkx_contagion %>%  
  group_by(source, target) %>%
  summarise(weight = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()
#iron_march_edges_networkx_contagion

write.table(iron_march_edges_networkx_contagion,"iron_march_edges_networkx_contagion.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

# Comments from users 

iron_march_edges_networkx <- iron_march_edges
names(iron_march_edges_networkx)[names(iron_march_edges_networkx) == "time half"] <- "half" #match iron_march_edges_ids
#head(iron_march_edges_networkx,5)

iron_march_edges_networkx_contagion_comments <-
sqldf("SELECT source, target
FROM iron_march_edges_networkx 
WHERE  [type] = 'Comment'
AND [half] IN ('2016.1', '2016.2', '2017.1', '2017.2')
ORDER BY timestamp DESC")

# Create weights of comments
iron_march_edges_networkx_contagion_comments <- iron_march_edges_networkx_contagion_comments %>%  
  group_by(source, target) %>%

ORDER BY timestamp DESC")

# Create weights

iron_march_edges_networkx_contagion_all_edges$target<-gsub('[\"]',"",as.character(iron_march_edges_networkx_contagion_all_edges$target))

tibble(iron_march_edges_networkx_contagion_comments)
```

## CREATING THE NETWORK

```{r}
library(igraph)
iron_march_network <- graph_from_data_frame(d=iron_march_edges_ids_prep, vertices=iron_march_nodes, directed=T) 
iron_march_network

E(iron_march_network)       # The edges of the "net" object
V(iron_march_network)       # The vertices of the "net" object

# Specific data descrptions on attributes
edgetypes <- E(iron_march_network)$type  # Edge attribute "type"
roletypes <- V(iron_march_network)$role # Vertex attribute "role"

edgetypestable <- table(edgetypes) # create table
roletypestable <- table(roletypes) # create table

edgetypesdf <- as.data.frame(edgetypestable) # create dataframe
edgetypesdf

roletypesdf <- as.data.frame(roletypestable) # create dataframe
roletypesdf 

# Node Types
roletypesdf %>% 
  mutate(roletypes = fct_reorder(roletypes, Freq)) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x=roletypes, y=Freq)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", alpha=.6, width=.4) +
    coord_flip() +
    xlab("") +
    theme_bw() + 
  ggtitle("Breakdown of Iron March Node Roles", subtitle = "All Node Roles Included") +
  xlab("Type of Role") + ylab("Frequency of Role")  +
geom_label(
    aes(label=Freq), 
    nudge_x = 0, nudge_y = 15, 
    check_overlap = T,
    size = 3) 

# without Posts
roletypesdf %>% filter(roletypes != c("Iron March Post", "Iron March Event")) %>% # exclude IM Post 
  mutate(roletypes = fct_reorder(roletypes, Freq)) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x=roletypes, y=Freq)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", alpha=.6, width=.4) +
    coord_flip() +
    xlab("") +
    theme_bw() + 
  ggtitle("Breakdown of Iron March Node Roles", subtitle = "Node Role Members Only") +
  xlab("Type of Role") + ylab("Frequency of Role")  +

# Edge Types
edgetypesdf %>%

  ggplot( aes(x=edgetypes, y=Freq)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", alpha=.6, width=.4) +
    coord_flip() +
    xlab("") +
    theme_bw() + 
  ggtitle("Breakdown of Iron March Edges", subtitle = "All Edges Roles Included") +

geom_label(
```

# Alpha Centrality
```{r}
# Calculable centrality types based on the graph structure
library(CINNA)
pr_cent<-proper_centralities(iron_march_network)

# It is a measure of centrality of nodes within a graph. 
# It is an adaptation of eigenvector centrality with the addition that nodes are imbued with importance from external sources.

alpha_network <- alpha_centrality(iron_march_network, alpha=0.9)

write.csv(alpha_network, "alpha_network_scores.csv", sep = ",",
            row.names = TRUE, col.names = FALSE)

alpha_df <- read.csv(file="alpha_network_scores.csv", header=FALSE, sep=",")

")
```

# Bridges 
```{r}
# Александр Славрос is acting as bridge between two nodes who are the furthest apart
# Further explained below using ego graph:

#The first argument of ego() is the graph object, 
#the second argument is the maximum number of connections between the vertices, 
#the third argument is the vertex of interest, 
#and the fourth argument determines if you are considering connections going out or into the vertex of interest.
# https://rpubs.com/yanalytics/network-analysis-directed1

# Identify vertices that are reachable within two connections from vertex Александр Славрос
ego(iron_march_network, 2, 'Александр Славрос', mode = c('out'))
round(5362/7415*100, digits = 2)
# 5362/7415 or 72.31% of all vertices can be reached within two steps from Александр Славрос

ego(iron_march_network, 2, 'Александр Славрос', mode = c('in'))
round(434/7415*100, digits = 2)
# 434/7415 or just 5.85% of all vertices can be reached within two steps to Александр Славрос

```

# Node degrees
```{r}
# 'degree' has a mode of 'in' for in-degree, 'out' for out-degree,
# and 'all' or 'total' for total degree. 
deg <- degree(iron_march_network, mode="all")
degree(iron_march_network)
```
# Degree distribution

(Barabasi, 2014)

Superlinear Regime (α>1)
- The high-degree nodes are disproportionately attractive. 
- A winner-takes-all dynamics leads to a hub-and-spoke topology. 
- In this configuration the earliest nodes become super hubs and all subsequent nodes link to them.

```{r}
# List of degrees
G.degrees <- degree(iron_march_network)

# Count the frequencies of each degree
G.degree.histogram <- as.data.frame(table(G.degrees))

# Need to convert the first column to numbers, otherwise
# the log-log thing will not work (that's fair...)
G.degree.histogram[,1] <- as.numeric(G.degree.histogram[,1])

# Plot
ggplot(G.degree.histogram, aes(x = G.degrees, y = Freq)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous("Degree\n(nodes with this amount of connections)",
                     breaks = c(1, 3, 10, 30, 100, 300),
                     trans = "log10") +
  scale_y_continuous("Frequency\n(how many of them)",
                     breaks = c(1, 3, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000),
                     trans = "log10") +
  ggtitle("Degree Distribution (log-log)") +
  theme_bw()

```

# Degree (number of ties)
```{r}
V(iron_march_network)$degree <- degree(iron_march_network)                        # Degree centrality
V(iron_march_network)$eig <- evcent(iron_march_network)$vector                    # Eigenvector centrality
V(iron_march_network)$hubs <- hub.score(iron_march_network)$vector                # "Hub" centrality
V(iron_march_network)$authorities <- authority.score(iron_march_network)$vector   # "Authority" centrality
V(iron_march_network)$closeness <- closeness(iron_march_network)                  # Closeness centrality
V(iron_march_network)$betweenness <- betweenness(iron_march_network)
```

## Centrality Degree Measures
```{r}
Degree.Directed <- degree(iron_march_network)
Indegree <- degree(iron_march_network, mode="in")
Outdegree <- degree(iron_march_network, mode="out")
CentreDegree <- centr_degree(iron_march_network, mode="in", normalized=T)

# Make a histogram of out-degrees
hist(Indegree, breaks = 20)
hist(Outdegree, breaks = 20)
hist(Degree.Directed, breaks = 20)

CompareDegree <- cbind(Degree.Directed, Indegree, Outdegree, CentreDegree)
head(CompareDegree)

CompareDegree

# Highest number of degrees - most central node
V(iron_march_network)$name[degree(iron_march_network)==max(degree(iron_march_network))]
max(degree(iron_march_network))
# "Liberal Degeneration" Iron March Post # 10,311

# Highest number of degrees - most central node
# Betweenness centrality reflects how connected nodes are. 
# More precisely, it provides a measure of how important noes are for information flow between nodes in a network. 
V(iron_march_network)$name[betweenness(iron_march_network)==max(betweenness(iron_march_network))]
max(betweenness(iron_march_network))
# "Александр Славрос" Iron March Admin # 1286664

# df with degrees
iron_march_degree <- data.frame(nodename = V(iron_march_network)$name, noderole = V(iron_march_network)$role,
                         Degree   = Degree.Directed)

iron_march_indegree <- data.frame(nodename = V(iron_march_network)$name, noderole = V(iron_march_network)$role,
                         InDegree   = Indegree)

iron_march_outdegree <- data.frame(nodename = V(iron_march_network)$name, noderole = V(iron_march_network)$role,
                         OutDegree   = Outdegree)

iron_march_centdegree <- data.frame(nodename = V(iron_march_network)$name, noderole = V(iron_march_network)$role,
                         CentreDegree   = CentreDegree)

iron_march_indegree_table <- data.frame(InDegree   = Indegree)
iron_march_outdegree_table <- data.frame(OutDegree   = Outdegree)
iron_march_centdegree_table <- data.frame(CentralDegree   = CentreDegree)
CompareIronDegree <- cbind(iron_march_degree, iron_march_indegree_table, iron_march_outdegree_table, iron_march_centdegree_table)
head(CompareIronDegree)
```

https://slcladal.github.io/net.html#Network_Statistics
```{r}
# Closeness centrality refers to the shortest paths between nodes. 
# The distance between two nodes represents the length of the shortest path between them. 
# The closeness of a node is the average distance from that node to all other nodes.
V(iron_march_network)$name[closeness(iron_march_network)==max(closeness(iron_march_network))]
max(closeness(iron_march_network))

#Suecorum Rex

```
# Reciprocity & Clustering Coeff
```{r}
# ‘Reciprocity’ calculates the proportion of mutual edges relative to all existing edges. 
# This is relevant for directed graphs.
reciprocity(graph = iron_march_network)
# 0.07886874

# ‘Clustering coefficient’ (also referred to as transitivity, or cliquishness) is the probability that the two neighbours of a vertex are neighbours of each other. 
# This is also called a triangle.

transitivity(graph = iron_march_network)
# 0.01707089
```

# CONSTRAINTS/BURT/HOLES

```{r}
# 0 - 1: Lower the actor’s Burt’s constraint score, lesser its behavior is constrained by other nodes in the network
# 0, if it is involved in many incomplete triads 
# 1, if it is involved in many complete triads

burt_im <- constraint(iron_march_network)

```

# Network Stats - Before
https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/igraph/versions/0.7.1/topics/centralization
https://igraph.org/r/doc/constraint.html

```{r}
before_nodes <- V(iron_march_network_before)
before_edges <- E(iron_march_network_before) # 78972
before_degree <- degree(iron_march_network_before) 
before_closeness <- closeness(iron_march_network_before) 
before_betweenness <- betweenness(iron_march_network_before) 
before_alpha<- alpha_centrality(iron_march_network_before, alpha=0.9) 
before_constraint <- constraint(iron_march_network_before)
before_trans <- transitivity(iron_march_network_before)
before_indegree <- degree(iron_march_network_before, mode = "in")
before_outdegree <- degree(iron_march_network_before, mode = "out")

#V(iron_march_network_before)$degree <- degree(iron_march_network_before) # Degree centrality 
#V(iron_march_network_before)$hubs <- hub.score(iron_march_network_before)$vector                # "Hub" centrality
#V(iron_march_network_before)$authorities <- authority.score(iron_march_network_before)$vector   # "Authority" centrality
#V(iron_march_network_before)$closeness <- closeness(iron_march_network_before)                  # Closeness centrality
#V(iron_march_network_before)$betweenness <- betweenness(iron_march_network_before) 

iron_march_network_before_density <- edge_density(iron_march_network_before, loops=F) # 0.001433875
iron_march_network_before_cent <- centralization.degree(iron_march_network_before, mode = "all") # 0.3406676
iron_march_network_before_btw <- centralization.betweenness(iron_march_network_before, directed = TRUE) # 0.002034856
iron_march_network_before_diam <- diameter(iron_march_network_before, directed=T) # 21
iron_march_network_before_dist <- mean_distance(iron_march_network_before) # 2.75189
iron_march_network_before_indegree <- centralization.degree(iron_march_network_before, mode = "in") # 0.6826773
iron_march_network_before_outdegree <- centralization.degree(iron_march_network_before, mode = "out") #0.42681

# Modularity  https://dshizuka.github.io/networkanalysis/05_community.html, https://users.dimi.uniud.it/~massimo.franceschet/R/communities.html

wtc <- cluster_walktrap(iron_march_network_before)
modularity(wtc)
iron_march_network_before_mod <- modularity(iron_march_network_before, membership(wtc)) # 0.1106328

```

# T TESTS

Not normally distributed so we use the Wilcox Test. If the p-value of the test is < 0.05, which is less than the significance level alpha = 0.05, we can conclude that the metric of the network before is significantly different from the metric after treatment with a p-value.

burt - https://ruqinren.wordpress.com/2018/03/01/hand-calculation-of-burts-constraint-in-networks/

```{r}
#Degree Test
degree_dif<-after_degree-before_degree

mean(before_degree) # 21.2615
sd(before_degree) # 136.2742

mean(after_degree) # 29.02711
sd(after_degree) # 174.2632

mean(degree_dif) # 7.76561
sd(degree_dif) # 

hist(degree_dif,main='Histogram for Difference in Degrees',xlab='Differences', breaks = 50) # normal?
qqnorm(degree_dif)
qqline(degree_dif)

# Kolmogorov-Smirnov Test
# D = 0.48092, p-value < 2.2e-16 (< .05 = non-normal)
ks.test(degree_dif, 'pnorm') 

# V = 9850659, p-value < 2.2e-16 (p < 0.001) 
degree_test <- wilcox.test(before_degree, after_degree, paired = TRUE)
degree_test

degree_zstat<-qnorm(degree_test$p.value/2) # https://www.simplypsychology.org/z-score.html
degree_zstat #-5.384035

# Cohen’sclassification of effect sizes which is 0.1 (small effect), 0.3 (moderate effect) and 0.5 and
# above (large effect).


# t = -4.1602, df = 7414, p-value = 3.215e-05 / mean diff = 7.874848 (nodes increased their degrees by 7.8)
#t.test(before_degree,after_degree, paired = TRUE)

```

```{r}
colnames(iron_march_comments_posts)
```

# T TESTS

Not normally distributed so we use the Wilcox Test. If the p-value of the test is < 0.05, which is less than the significance level alpha = 0.05, we can conclude that the metric of the network before is significantly different from the metric after treatment with a p-value.

burt - https://ruqinren.wordpress.com/2018/03/01/hand-calculation-of-burts-constraint-in-networks/

```{r}
#Degree Test
degree_dif<-trump_after_degree-trump_before_degree

mean(trump_before_degree) # 22.03234
sd(trump_before_degree) # 13.21329

mean(trump_after_degree) # 20.92123
sd(trump_after_degree) # 42.29446

mean(degree_dif) # 2.732587
sd(degree_dif) # 62.89549

# Kolmogorov-Smirnov Test
#D = 0.48732, p-value < 2.2e-166 (< .05 = non-normal)
ks.test(degree_dif, 'pnorm') 

# W = 299586, p-value = 0.8638 (p > 0.05) 
degree_test <- wilcox.test(trump_before_degree, trump_after_degree, paired = FALSE)
degree_test

```
```{r}
#out and in Test

out_dif<-trump_after_outdegree-trump_before_outdegree

mean(trump_before_outdegree) # 11.01617
sd(trump_before_outdegree) # 36.25197
mean(trump_after_outdegree) # 10.46061
sd(trump_after_outdegree) # 33.38157
mean(degree_dif) # 2.732587
sd(degree_dif) # 2.077054

# Kolmogorov-Smirnov Test
#D = 0.48732, p-value < 2.2e-166 (< .05 = non-normal)
ks.test(degree_dif, 'pnorm') 

# W = 291004, p-value = 0.1946 (p > 0.05) 
outtest <- wilcox.test(trump_before_outdegree, trump_after_outdegree, paired = FALSE)
outtest

#-----------> in <------------

in_dif<-trump_after_indegree-trump_before_indegree

mean(trump_before_indegree) #11.01617
sd(trump_before_indegree) # 30.80572
mean(trump_after_indegree) # 10.46061
sd(trump_after_indegree) # 22.80128
mean(degree_dif) # 2.732587
sd(degree_dif) # 2.077054

# Kolmogorov-Smirnov Test
#D = 0.22725, p-value = 1.331e-07 (< .05 = non-normal)
ks.test(in_dif, 'pnorm') 

# W = 315944, p-value = 0.08994 (p > 0.05) 
intest <- wilcox.test(trump_before_indegree, trump_after_indegree, paired = FALSE)
intest
```

```{r}
median(trump_after_degree) # 0.2057991
sd(trump_after_degree) # 2.096922

mean(degree_dif) # -0.04477411
sd(degree_dif) # 2.077054

# Kolmogorov-Smirnov Test
#D = 0.48732, p-value < 2.2e-166 (< .05 = non-normal)
ks.test(degree_dif, 'pnorm') 

# W = 13150, p-value = 0.4682 (p > 0.05) 
centtest <- wilcox.test(trump_before_cent, trump_after_cent, paired = FALSE)
centtest

#t = 1.3967, df = 315, p-value = 0.1635
t.test(trump_before_degree, trump_after_degree,var.equal = T)
```
